description: Anchor vocabulary for Class 4 (CONTROL) events. A CONTROL event is a control-plane state change; the control_subtype declares which control surface the event changes, and the anchor_requirements declare what the event MUST reference for the change to be auditable. Status draft: per the gated-registry rule, draft vocabularies impose no live validation obligation. Promotion path: SEM-021 (reserved) will make control_subtype mandatory for Class 4 events when this registry graduates to active.
anchor_principle: Every CONTROL event must point at the thing it changes. A control-plane event with no referent is unauditable and is the class-4 analogue of an unscoped executing Action.

entries.name: Registry Update
entries.description: A change to an Arrow controlled vocabulary or registry entry (origins, actions, classes, regimes, chain/bridge registries).

entries.name: Chain Status Transition
entries.description: A chain observation/trust state transition (e.g. ACTIVE → CONDITIONAL per DIV-003, chain_trust_flag changes per SEM-016/CHN-003).
anchor_requirements: triggering event in related_events (e.g. divergence event)

entries.name: Bridge Status Transition
entries.description: A bridge trust transition: disable (BRG-001/002) or restoration (BRG-005).

entries.name: Protocol Upgrade
entries.description: A protocol- or chain-level upgrade declaration: consensus mechanism change, version upgrade, fork scheduling. Mid-to-major technical changes that re-baseline what downstream consumers may assume about an Origin (cf. CHN-004 registry-version triggers).

entries.name: Node / Validator Topology Change
entries.description: A change to the verifier/validator/node set that an Origin's verification regime depends on: validator-set rotation, DVN/OVN membership or threshold changes, quorum reconfiguration for bonded_quorum regimes.
anchor_requirements: set or threshold before and after

entries.name: Parameter Change
entries.description: A bounded numeric or configuration parameter change at protocol or deployment-policy level (e.g. challenge-window duration, confidence thresholds, restoration ceiling periods).

entries.name: Emergency Declaration
entries.description: An exceptional declared-policy action by a pre-mandated emergency authority (Origin EMG). The declaration itself is the control-plane event; any asset effect is a separate, normally-validated event.

entries.name: Supersession
entries.description: Explicit supersession of a prior final event per SEM-014. The Class 4 supersession path is one of exactly two ways a Finality=1 event may be contradicted (the other is Class 1 State RV reversal).
